# skycloak_application_sessions (Data Source)

Active user sessions for an application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_application_sessions" "web" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  client_id  = skycloak_application.web.client_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Application client ID.
- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.

### Read-Only

- `sessions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))

<a id="nestedatt--sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sessions`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) User email.
- `id` (String) Session ID.
- `ip_address` (String) Originating IP address.
- `last_access_at` (String) Last activity (RFC 3339).
- `started_at` (String) Session start (RFC 3339).
- `user_id` (String) User ID.
- `username` (String) Username.
